blockers.wanted: a looping roar from filtered brown noise with a wander amplitude, passing loop_seam
blockers.tried: the manual says noise loops pass easily; a plain brown noise lp 220 Hz x wander + white hp hiss + voices crackles failed loop_seam at 4.07x the p99 step (the filtered low-frequency roar jumps at the wrap)
blockers.workaround: mirror loop by hand per layer: env step at D/2, reverse node, two math mul, one math add (10 extra nodes); wrap discontinuity then 0.13x, spectral change 1.9 dB
the argument is named `kind`; with the wrong name the call succeeds and returns the full node list, so five calls were wasted

blockers.wanted: a macro (crackle density on poisson rate) with no measurable claim
blockers.workaround: dropped the density macro; errors were 'missing field `claim`' and 'expected tuple struct Claim' without naming the macro, and the manual does not say claim is required

blockers.tried: crack_g db -12..+6 gave crest 14.60 14.58 14.54 16.67 17.55 (flat then rising), FAIL
blockers.workaround: shifted the range to 0..+12 dB by trial; the claim passes (15.27 to 19.67 dB). Needed to guess which part of the range moves the measure.
